examples.note: Panama City — the leading 2 or 3 encodes location
Mobile — 8-digit numbers beginning with 6, introduced August 2005

notes: Panama has no area codes. Fixed lines are 7 digits with geography encoded in the first digit; mobile numbers are 8 digits beginning with 6.
Numbers are recycled after a subscriber cancels or goes inactive.
sources: ASEP — Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos: https://www.asep.gob.pa/
